name: SAFE Expect Respect Summer Youth Leadership Academy
what_you_do: A paid five-week summer job at SAFE. You get job and leadership training and work on real projects in media, outreach and education about healthy relationships and stopping bullying and abuse.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 17. You register through the Austin and Travis County summer youth jobs program.
pay_detail: Paid part-time. The rate is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Registration goes through Travis County's Summer Youth Employment Program, which opens Summer 2027 applications in January 2027 (exact date not posted).
how_to_apply: Register ahead of time through the Travis County Summer Youth Employment Program page linked from SAFE. Questions: Randy Randolph, Rrandolph@safeaustin.org, 512-356-1633.
notes: SAFE also runs free Expect Respect leadership sessions in schools and clubs by request. Travis County's program may consider household income.
